question: Which materials for vessels are enumerated in this teaching?
premises: A vessel made of clay is named
A vessel born of a tortoise is named
Vessels made of bell metal and copper metal are named
inference: The enumerated vessels include those made of clay, tortoise-born, bell metal, and copper metal
plain_english: O goddess, vessels made of clay, born of a tortoise, made of bell metal, and made of copper.
